contexts.text: So ordinated that they cannot be described.
Indefinite things in a most ordinate form...
Ordinated most distinctly into Societies.
They set in array the battle () = they attacked.
The ordination and influx of the Lord into His Natural. Signified, Explained.

The Societies of Heaven are ordinated by the Lord according to the Divine form... The form of the Spiritual Kingdom comes forth according to the ordination of the affections in His Human. Treated of. AC 4041.
The Rational ordinates all things in the Natural; and views Things according to the ordination there.
The innumerable Societies there are disposed and ordinated according to...
Ordination in generals. Signified, Explained.
As man prefers heavenly things, so are the things in his Natural ordinated to the state of Heaven... It is ends which ordinate; that is, the Lord through ends. Explained.
Hence it is evident what ordination in generals is... all the causes and effects are ordinated according to the end itself...
Ordination in the way they were to be initiated. Signified, Explained.
To be ordinated according to the life. Signified.
This ordination (in the memory) is effected by the good which inflows. AC 5288:2.
Which will ordinate all things in the natural mind. Signified, Explained.
It is good and truth which ordinate each and all things in the natural mind. Explained.
The heavenly form is the form into which the heavenly Societies are ordinated; and they are ordinated according to the form which is induced by the good and truth which proceed from the Lord.
The ordination of generals in the Natural. Signified, Explained.
The ordinations of the truths conferred gratis. Signified, Explained.
Binding, or a bundle = ordination.
In this general, the particulars; and, in these, the singulars, are ordinated.
Such is the ordination with the man who is in the good of love...
A new disposition and ordination of truths in the Natural. Signified, Explained.
Such is the ordination of goods with the regenerate. But with the evil...
The ordination of the truths of faith and goods of love in the Natural. Signified, Explained.
Concerning the tribes and their ordinations.
That themselves should ordinate themselves. Signified, Explained.

To gather together = to be ordinated for truths and goods cannot be gathered together unless they are ordinated; for the Universal which proceeds from the Lord effects this. Explained... It then appears as if goods and truths ordinate themselves, and thus flow into order spontaneously. (Continued. See Order.)
Nothing ordinate and regular could come forth in the body; but... then all things are ordinated as of themselves.
If the things in the memory are ordinated...
The Lord is continually ordinating the Heavens.
When the Lord ordinates the Heavens, the Hells which are in the opposite are ordinated of themselves.
The Lord is continually ordinating Heaven... This ordination causes the evil to be devastated by degrees. Explained.
It is this influx by which the Societies in the Second Heaven are disposed or ordinated as to their goods.
To encamp = the ordination of truth and good to undergo temptations.
This ordination under generals causes the singles to act a one, and to be in a form, and to have a quality together.
Ordination by Divine truth. Signified, Explained.
By Divine truth are ordinated all things in Heaven and in Hell: hence comes all order on earth also.
That after the temptation the truths of faith were ordinated through the good of love. Signified, Explained.
For all the ordination of truths is done through the good of love. Explained.
The image of man's spirit... is exactly according to the ordination of truths by good with him.
Goods and truths are implanted in man through temptations; but they are not ordinated until afterwards... The ordination takes place in a calm.
The Universal forming and ordinating each and all things, is the Divine good of the Divine love from the Lord.
The ordination of the interiors to undergo temptation as to truth. Signified, Explained.
The ordination of truths by Divine good. Treated of.
The ordination of truths with the man of the Spiritual Church, which is done by Divine good through Divine truth. Tr... For all ordination is by good through truth.
This ordination takes place with the man of the Spiritual Church, when he begins to act no longer from truth but from good...
The ordination of the good and truth of the Church near the good of truth. Signified, Explained.
Effect according to the ordination of Divine good. Signified, Explained.
Not among the truths which are ordinated in a general under good.
According to the order in which the Lord ordinates Heaven.
These bundles and series are mutually ordinated so as to relate to the heavenly form.
The muscles and motor fibres are so ordinated as to concur to every action...
The encampments represented the ordination of all things in the Heavens according to the truths and goods of faith and love. References.
The subjugation of the Hells; the ordination of the Heavens...
Aaron and his sons shall order it () = perpetual influx from the Lord. To order, or ordinate, when predicated of the Lord, = influx...

For everything which the Lord ordinates, that is, provides, is eternal. (Thus) the ordering, or ordinating, of the lamp from evening to morning = the perpetual influx of good and truth from the Lord constantly in every state.
That interior things are to be ordinated distinctly. Signified, Explained.
With those being regenerated, the interiors and exteriors are ordinated by the Lord for all the sequent states. Explained.
Hence it is that whatever the Lord disposes and ordinates is eternal.
There are in man external, internal, and inmost things: all these are disposed and ordinated together and successively for the reception of sequent things to eternity. Explained.
The ordination of the exteriors under the interiors and inmosts. Signified, Explained.
As to ordination and disposition. Signified, Explained.

To number, when predicated of the things of the Church, = the ordination and disposition of them... For to number involves a survey; and what is surveyed by the Lord is also ordinated and disposed. Illustrated.

As it belongs to the Lord alone to ordinate and dispose the truths and goods of faith and love... therefore when this is done by man, as by David, there is signified the ordination and disposition of such things by man and not the Lord; which is not to ordinate and dispose; but to destroy.
For with these the truths and goods of faith and love can be ordinated and disposed by the Lord; for the Lord inflows into their Intellectual and Voluntary, and ordinates and disposes.
Those at the right were ordinated according to the quality of the good; and those at the left according to the quality of the evil, with them...
The quality of every form is from the ordination among themselves of the various things therein...
The Reformed... are ordinated there according to their countries...
But there is a different ordination of all in Heaven, and in Hell.
All the ordination of the Societies in that World is an ordination according to the differences of love... The Lord, who is Divine love itself, ordinates them according to the receptions of it...
Although these live dispersed, they are ordinated in a similar way. Explained.
Still, the ordination of the whole Heaven differs from the ordination of a Society, as the general from the particular...

For (the loves) are thus ordinated with man; although man knows nothing whatever of their ordination; but something of it is manifested to him in the other life; for he has extension of thought and affection there according to their ordination...
The places of instruction... are ordinate and distinct according to the genera and species of celestial goods.
The ordinations (in the places of instruction) are, in general, as follows...
The Hells are so ordinately distinct according to the differences of each evil, that nothing is more ordinate and distinct.
How all things are ordinated in the Heavens and the Hells so as... to be in equilibrium... All the Societies of Heaven are most ordinately distinct according to goods...
Some of the means relate to the ordination of those who are in Hells.
That the Lord at the same time ordinated Heaven, so that it should make a one with the Church.
Ordinated according to degrees of height.
The ordination of affections in Heaven, and of concupiscences in Hell, is marvellous, and known to the Lord alone...

All the Societies... are marvellously ordinated according to natural affections... The Societies ordinated according to good natural affections communicate with Heaven; and those ordinated according to evil natural affections, with Hell.
A manifestation concerning the ordination of the Heavens for the Last Judgment... Signified, Explained. AR 233. AE 258.
By the ordinations of ministries.
The universal Heaven is ordinated according to all the varieties of the affections of the love of good; and the universal Hell according to all the affections of the love of evil. AE 430:3.
The (Angels) have been ordinated, and are being ordinated, by the Lord into one form...
Three degrees... according to which the angelic Heavens are ordinated; and according to which human minds are ordinated.
Redemption was... the ordination of the Heavens... TCR 86. TCR 115, General article. TCR 117. TCR 118:end.
The ordination of the Heavens and Hells has gone on from the Last Judgment to the present time.
The Societies of Heaven are ordinated according to... TCR 569:3.
This organization is an ordination of all things in series...

Unless there were such an ordination of substances in the human mind, man would have nothing analytic of reason, which everyone has according to the ordination... and the ordination is according to the use of reason from freedom.
The affections of good and truth are so ordinated that...
Similarly is the Church ordinated...
The Angels ordinated them all into four companies... To whom, thus ordinated, we said...
All (there) are most distinctly ordinated in general and in every part... On this distinct ordination the conservation of the universe depends.
What are these ordinations without signs...
The ordination of all (the viscera) to uses.
The Divine ordination of the Societies effects that...
This is effected by the ordination of (the internals) by the Lord.
One who knew how to ordinate these Societies according to order... The ordination of them was into a form opposite to that of Heaven.
The ordination of the Heavens at the Last Judgment. Explained.
Which they read daily, according to the ecclesiastical ordination.
In () it treats of the ordination of all things before the Judgment.
This ordination (of the Heavens) depends on the infinite wisdom of the One who knows all things. He Knows and explores all things; and thence disposes and ordinates all things.
This ordination is to the end that all may be kept in connection by influx: such is the coordinate and subordinate disposition through the whole Spiritual World.
All are ordinated (there) according to the quarters.
What is signified by the ordinations according to the quarters in the Word.
The ordinations of the tribes represented the ordinations of the Societies in the Heavens.
The ordination of all things in the Heavens from Own power through Divine truth. Signified.
Such is the ordination of the universal Heaven; in each Society there; in each city there; and also in each house.

Such is the ordination there, that the Heavens are like expanses, one above another; beneath the Heavens is the World of Spirits; and beneath this the Hells, one below another. The influx from the Lord takes place according to this successive ordination...
But this ordination of the Heavens and Hells has undergone changes from one Judgment to another. (Explained.)
The universal Heaven is ordinated into Societies according to ... AE 1093:2.
An ordinance appointed, that... Signified, Explained. AE 833.
To make a statute, or ordain that...
From this ordination comes forth the form of Heaven.
(The Babylonians) ordained that...
Believing the things they ordained were accepted.
The ordination of so many various affections (of) men from the first creation...
He was permitted to ordinate those in that small Society, and ordinated them as a spider does its web...
There is a most perfect ordination of all in the Heavens and in the Hells. Explained.
